motivation.text: Scanning an array of $\Theta(n)$ stored bits at each of $\Theta(\log n)$ transform levels already costs $\Theta(n\log n)$, so the logarithmic factor can only be beaten by cheaper address movement and cheaper butterfly arithmetic.
